measure.evidenceText: The returned Expedia results list Johannesburg star-rating counts and a generic all-hotel price trend, plus individual 3-star properties, but no exact-city 3-star class trend value. Generic and single-property prices cannot substitute for a class average.
measure.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; generic city trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days.
